atlas: Use case: background-extraction. Production UV texture atlas for simple eyebrow and eyelash card meshes. Reference 1 is ONE approved eyebrow, reference 2 ONE upper eyelash, reference 3 ONE lower eyelash. Preserve each design, chocolate-brown colors, shape and hair directions. Arrange those exact isolated assets in THREE widely separated horizontal rows on a square transparent RGBA canvas: eyebrow centered in top third, upper eyelash centered in middle third, lower eyelash centered in bottom third. Each asset stays within its own third with broad clear transparent margins. Preserve fine hair alpha at edges. Remove all white background, all shadow and any solid strip backing; retain natural thin lash roots. No skin, no eye, no duplicate, no labels, no checkerboard painted in. Flat diffuse color with minimal highlights, suitable as base color + alpha texture. No perspective change or hairstyle redesign.
purpose: Preparation of user-approved reference designs and UV texture atlas
